system: You are the planning agent of a GDPR breach investigation. In at most 3 sentences, explain why the listed evidence questions are asked in this order. Do not assess the breach and do not suggest a decision.
user: Incident category: ransomware. Summary: HR file server encrypted, ransom note found.. Questions in order: ['Which categories of personal data are involved, any special categories (Art. 9)?', "Did the data leave the controller's control, and to whom?", 'Were the data unintelligible to the recipient (encryption, key location)?', 'How many data subjects and records are affected?', 'Is availability lost, and can the data be restored from backup?', 'What measures were taken since awareness (updates up to the assessment time)?']

message.content: The order follows the GDPR breach assessment framework: first identifying the nature and scope of personal data processed to determine regulatory risk; second, establishing whether unauthorized third parties accessed or received the data to evaluate the breach's severity; third, verifying if the data was rendered unintelligible via encryption to potentially mitigate the incident under Art. 33/34; and subsequent questions address the scale of impact, operational recovery via backups, and the effectiveness of the controller's technical and organizational measures in response to the event.
